kept.name: reverse_string
kept.description: Returns the input string with its characters in reverse order.

kept.name: capitalize_title
kept.description: Capitalizes the first letter of each word in the input string while leaving other characters unchanged.

kept.name: extract_hashtags
kept.description: Finds and returns all hashtag tokens (words prefixed with #) from the input string as a list.

kept.name: normalize_whitespace
kept.description: Collapses consecutive whitespace characters into a single space and trims leading/trailing whitespace.

kept.name: euler_totient
kept.description: Computes Euler's totient function φ(n), the count of positive integers ≤ n that are coprime to n. Returns an integer.

kept.name: mobius_function
kept.description: Computes the Möbius function μ(n) for integer n ≥ 1, returning -1 if n has an odd number of distinct prime factors, 1 if even number, and 0 if any prime factor squared divides n. Returns -1, 0, or 1.

kept.name: sum_of_divisors
kept.description: Calculates the sum of all positive divisors of n, denoted σ(n). Returns the integer sum.

kept.name: modular_inverse
kept.description: Finds the modular multiplicative inverse of a modulo m, i.e., an integer x such that (a * x) ≡ 1 (mod m). Assumes a and m are coprime; returns the inverse or raises an error if none exists.

kept.name: area_of_circle
kept.description: Computes the area of a circle given its radius and returns the result as a floating‑point number.

kept.name: perimeter_of_rectangle
kept.description: Calculates the perimeter of a rectangle from its width and height and returns the perimeter as a floating‑point number.

kept.name: volume_of_sphere
kept.description: Determines the volume of a sphere given its radius and returns the volume as a floating‑point number.

kept.name: distance_between_2d_points
kept.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between two points in a 2‑dimensional plane given their coordinates.

kept.name: convert_length
kept.description: Converts a length value from one unit (e.g., mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi) to another, returning the converted value as a float.

kept.name: convert_volume
kept.description: Converts a volume value between units such as ml, l, cm³, m³, tsp, tbsp, fl oz, cup, pt, qt, gal, returning the result as a float.

kept.name: convert_mass
kept.description: Converts a mass value among units like mg, g, kg, t, oz, lb, stone, returning the converted value as a float.

kept.name: convert_time
kept.description: Converts a time duration between units such as s, min, h, day, week, month (30 days), year (365 days), returning the result as a float.

kept.name: is_leap_year
kept.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year in the Gregorian calendar. Returns true if leap year, false otherwise.

kept.name: week_of_year
kept.description: Returns the ISO week number (1‑53) for a given date. Input date must be in ISO‑8601 format (YYYY‑MM‑DD).

kept.name: days_in_month
kept.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month and year. Accounts for leap years in February.

kept.name: time_to_next_birthday
kept.description: Calculates the number of days from today (or a reference date) until the next occurrence of a given birthday. Input birthday in ISO‑8601 format; optionally provide a reference date.

kept.name: debt_to_income_ratio
kept.description: Calculates the debt-to-income ratio by dividing total monthly debt payments by monthly gross income, returning a decimal ratio.

kept.name: loan_to_value_ratio
kept.description: Computes the loan-to-value (LTV) ratio as the loan amount divided by the appraised property value, expressed as a decimal.

kept.name: net_worth_calculator
kept.description: Determines net worth by subtracting total liabilities from total assets and returns the result.

kept.name: apr_calculator
kept.description: Converts a nominal interest rate and compounding frequency into an effective annual percentage rate (APR).

nominal_rate.description: Nominal annual interest rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

compounding_per_year.description: Number of compounding periods per year

kept.name: median
kept.description: Returns the median (middle value) of a list of numbers. For even-length lists, it returns the average of the two central values.

kept.name: variance
kept.description: Calculates the population variance of a list of numbers, measuring the average squared deviation from the mean.

kept.name: interquartile_range
kept.description: Computes the interquartile range (IQR) as the difference between the 75th and 25th percentiles of a list of numbers.

kept.name: percentile_rank
kept.description: Given a value and a list of numbers, returns the percentile rank of the value (percentage of data points less than or equal to it).

kept.name: crc32_checksum
kept.description: Computes the CRC‑32 checksum of the input string and returns it as an unsigned 32‑bit integer.

kept.name: adler32_checksum
kept.description: Computes the Adler‑32 checksum of the input string and returns it as an unsigned 32‑bit integer.

kept.name: sha1_hex
kept.description: Calculates the SHA‑1 hash of the input string and returns the digest as a lowercase hexadecimal string.

kept.name: base32_encode
kept.description: Encodes the input string using Base32 (RFC 4648) and returns the encoded ASCII string.

kept.name: binary_search
kept.description: Performs binary search on a sorted list of numbers and returns the index of the target value, or -1 if the target is not present.

kept.name: merge_sorted_lists
kept.description: Merges two already sorted lists into a single sorted list while preserving the order of elements.

kept.name: rotate_list
kept.description: Rotates a list to the right by k positions (negative k rotates left) and returns the resulting list.

kept.name: find_longest_increasing_subsequence
kept.description: Computes the longest strictly increasing subsequence of a list of numbers and returns that subsequence as a list.

kept.name: hex_to_rgb
kept.description: Converts a hexadecimal colour string (e.g., '#FF5733' or 'FF5733') to its corresponding RGB integer values.

hex.description: Hex colour code, with or without leading #.

kept.name: rgb_to_hex
kept.description: Converts red, green, and blue integer components (0-255) to a hexadecimal colour string prefixed with '#'.

kept.name: colour_name_to_hex
kept.description: Maps a standard CSS colour name (e.g., 'tomato', 'steelblue') to its hexadecimal representation.

kept.name: calculate_contrast_ratio
kept.description: Computes the WCAG contrast ratio between two colours given as hex strings, returning a float ≥ 1.

kept.name: ohms_law_voltage
kept.description: Computes the voltage across a resistor using Ohm's law (V = I * R). Returns the voltage in volts given current in amperes and resistance in ohms.

kept.name: kinetic_energy
kept.description: Calculates the kinetic energy of an object using the formula KE = 0.5 * m * v^2. Returns energy in joules given mass in kilograms and velocity in meters per second.

kept.name: gravitational_potential_energy
kept.description: Computes gravitational potential energy (U = m * g * h). Returns energy in joules given mass in kilograms, height in meters, and optional gravitational acceleration (defaults to 9.81 m/s^2).

kept.name: resonant_frequency_lc
kept.description: Calculates the resonant frequency of an LC circuit using f = 1 / (2π * sqrt(L * C)). Returns frequency in hertz given inductance in henries and capacitance in farads.

kept.name: body_fat_percentage
kept.description: Estimates body fat percentage using the U.S. Navy circumference method for men or women.

kept.name: max_heart_rate
kept.description: Calculates estimated maximum heart rate (MHR) in beats per minute based on age using the common formula 220 - age.

kept.name: target_heart_rate_zone
kept.description: Returns the lower and upper bounds of the target heart rate zone for a given intensity percentage (e.g., 0.5 for 50%) based on age and resting heart rate.

kept.name: daily_caloric_needs
kept.description: Estimates total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) using the Mifflin‑St Jeor equation for basal metabolic rate multiplied by an activity factor.
